Maya: Starting 5% canary for entitlement-based routing, selector=tag:beta-entitlements.
Sam: How do quota overrides interact? We recently changed routing logic.
Maya: Quotas evaluate against primary table; canary sets scoped_token=true for service accounts. No quota rule changes.
Oliver: Risk: route movement may rebalance shards and spike CPU. Need route_affinity delta metric.
Sam: Also measure token_resolution_latency and session_scope propagation. If header missing Dedicated will misroute.
Lina: I'll add metrics: ent.route_affinity_change, ent.session_scope_seen, ent.quota_override_count. Trace span for token-resolve.
deploy-bot: Canary deployed to 38 tenants. Dashboard: https://console/redwood/d/ent-canary/1758882345
John: Add FF_entitlement_fallback and rollback if p95 latency or CPU >15%.
Maya: Playbook: 5% -> 45m monitor -> 20% pause to verify header propagation in 10/10 samples -> 50% -> full. Stop at 20% if propagation <100%.
Sam: Dedicated infra must forward session_scope header. I'll schedule change window.
Oliver: Logging note: add session_scope to entitlement-events index mapping.
Priya (product): Console: tenant detail should show canary state + one-click rollback + a short "why" blurb linking recent spikes. I can draft microcopy.
Maya: Great. Team, confirm when dashboards, infra forward, and modal copy are ready. :thumbsup:
Lina: Dashboards up, traces sampled at 0.5% for canary tenants.
Sam: Infra forward scheduled for 12:30 UTC.
deploy-bot: Canary ramped to 20% at 1758882460
